//: Bubo skin template. Only `id`, `displayName`, `author`, `accentColor`, `prefersDarkTint`, `backgroundGradient` and `previewColors` are required. Everything else is optional and uses sensible defaults.
author: @your_github
//secondaryAccent: Optional. Falls back to a dimmed accentColor.
//barTint: Optional subtle color wash on the top/bottom bars.
//platterTint: Optional subtle color wash on card surfaces.
//buttonStyle: One of: solid, gradient, glass. Default: gradient.
//buttonShape: One of: capsule, roundedRect, rectangle. Default: capsule.
//fontWeight: Body text weight. One of: regular, medium, semibold, bold. Default: regular. Headline and SF Symbol weights are derived automatically.
//fontDesign: System font face. One of: rounded, default, serif, monospaced. Default: rounded.
//badgeStyle: One of: tinted, filled, outlined. Default: tinted.
//separatorStyle: One of: subtle, system, accent, none. Default: subtle.
